passages.text: Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.
passages.sermon:
Brothers, you are spiritual people.
If someone is caught in a sin, restore that person.
Restore him with a gentle spirit.
Watch yourself.
You also may be tempted.
passages.original: Ἀδελφοί ἐὰν καὶ προλημφθῇ ἄνθρωπος ἔν τινι παραπτώματι ὑμεῖς οἱ πνευματικοὶ καταρτίζετε τὸν τοιοῦτον ἐν πνεύματι πραΰτητος σκοπῶν σεαυτόν μὴ καὶ σὺ πειρασθῇς

passages.text: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
passages.sermon: Christ commands his followers to love and help each other.\r\nYou must carry each other's burdens.\r\nWhen you do this, you fulfill the law of Christ.
passages.original: Ἀλλήλων τὰ βάρη βαστάζετε καὶ οὕτως ἀναπληρώσετε τὸν νόμον τοῦ Χριστοῦ

passages.text: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
passages.sermon: If a person thinks he is important, but he is actually nothing, he deceives himself.\r\nHe believes something false about himself.\r\nHe does not see the truth about his own condition.
passages.original: εἰ γὰρ δοκεῖ τις εἶναί τι μηδὲν ὤν φρεναπατᾷ ἑαυτόν

passages.text: Each one should test his own work. Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else.
passages.sermon:
Each person must examine his own work.
He must look at what he has done.
Then he will have a reason to be proud of himself.
He will not compare himself to another person.
He will not boast because of someone else.
passages.original: Τὸ δὲ ἔργον ἑαυτοῦ δοκιμαζέτω ἕκαστος καὶ τότε εἰς ἑαυτὸν μόνον τὸ καύχημα ἕξει καὶ οὐκ εἰς τὸν ἕτερον

passages.text: For each one should carry his own load.
passages.sermon: Each person must carry his own load.\r\nNo one else can carry it for him.\r\nGod expects each person to be responsible for his own burden.
passages.original: ἕκαστος γὰρ τὸ ἴδιον φορτίον βαστάσει

passages.text: Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with his instructor.
passages.sermon:
A person receives instruction in the word of God.
This person is called a student.
Another person teaches the word of God.
This person is called an instructor.
The student must share all good things with the instructor.
The student must not keep good things only for himself.
The student must give good things to the instructor as well.
passages.original: Κοινωνείτω δὲ ὁ κατηχούμενος τὸν λόγον τῷ κατηχοῦντι ἐν πᾶσιν ἀγαθοῖς

passages.text: Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.
passages.sermon:
God is not to be mocked.
Do not be deceived.
God sees all things.
God judges truly.
Whatever a person sows, that person will also reap.
Each person receives the result of his own actions.
passages.original: Μὴ πλανᾶσθε Θεὸς οὐ μυκτηρίζεται ὃ γὰρ ἐὰν σπείρῃ ἄνθρωπος τοῦτο καὶ θερίσει

passages.text: The one who sows to please his flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; but the one who sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.
passages.sermon:
A person can choose what to pursue in life.
Some people live to please their own flesh.
These people sow to the flesh.
They will reap destruction from the flesh.
Other people live to please the Spirit of God.
These people sow to the Spirit.
They will reap eternal life from the Spirit.
passages.original: ὅτι ὁ σπείρων εἰς τὴν σάρκα ἑαυτοῦ ἐκ τῆς σαρκὸς θερίσει φθοράν ὁ δὲ σπείρων εἰς τὸ Πνεῦμα ἐκ τοῦ Πνεύματος θερίσει ζωὴν αἰώνιον

passages.text: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
passages.sermon:
Paul wrote this letter to the Galatians.
\r\nPaul encouraged believers to do good.
\r\nLet us not become tired of doing what is right.
\r\nWe must keep doing good works.
\r\nIf we do not give up, we will receive a reward at the right time.
\r\nGod will give us a harvest if we remain faithful.
passages.original: Τὸ δὲ καλὸν ποιοῦντες μὴ ἐνκακῶμεν καιρῷ γὰρ ἰδίῳ θερίσομεν μὴ ἐκλυόμενοι

passages.text: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.
passages.sermon:
Paul writes to Christians in Galatia.
Paul urges believers to act rightly.
We have opportunities to do good.
Let us do good to all people.
Let us especially do good to fellow believers.
Fellow believers are the family of faith.
passages.original: Ἄρα οὖν ὡς καιρὸν ἔχομεν ἐργαζώμεθα τὸ ἀγαθὸν πρὸς πάντας μάλιστα δὲ πρὸς τοὺς οἰκείους τῆς πίστεως

passages.text: See what large letters I am using to write to you with my own hand!
passages.sermon:
I am Paul.
\r\nI am writing this letter to you.
\r\nI am using my own hand.
\r\nI am writing with large letters.
passages.original: Ἴδετε πηλίκοις ὑμῖν γράμμασιν ἔγραψα τῇ ἐμῇ χειρί

passages.text: Those who want to make a good impression outwardly are trying to compel you to be circumcised. They only do this to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ.
passages.sermon:
Some people want to look good to others.
These people care about outward appearance.
They try to force you to be circumcised.
They do not act from true faith.
They want to avoid suffering for the cross of Christ.
They compel you so they will not be persecuted because of Jesus.
Their main goal is to escape trouble for following Christ.
passages.original: Ὅσοι θέλουσιν εὐπροσωπῆσαι ἐν σαρκί οὗτοι ἀναγκάζουσιν ὑμᾶς περιτέμνεσθαι μόνον ἵνα τῷ σταυρῷ τοῦ Χριστοῦ μὴ διώκωνται

passages.text: For the circumcised do not even keep the law themselves, yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.
passages.sermon: The circumcised people do not keep the law themselves.\r\nThey want you to be circumcised.\r\nThey want this so they can boast about your flesh.
passages.original: οὐδὲ γὰρ οἱ περιτεμνόμενοι αὐτοὶ νόμον φυλάσσουσιν ἀλλὰ θέλουσιν ὑμᾶς περιτέμνεσθαι ἵνα ἐν τῇ ὑμετέρᾳ σαρκὶ καυχήσωνται

passages.text: But as for me, may I never boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
passages.sermon:
Paul is the speaker.
\r\nPaul is a Christian apostle.
\r\nPaul refuses to boast about anything.
\r\nPaul will only boast in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ.
\r\nThe cross of Jesus Christ is the only thing Paul will boast about.
\r\nThrough the cross of Jesus Christ, the world has been crucified to Paul.
\r\nThrough the cross of Jesus Christ, Paul has been crucified to the world.
passages.original: Ἐμοὶ δὲ μὴ γένοιτο καυχᾶσθαι εἰ μὴ ἐν τῷ σταυρῷ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δι’ οὗ ἐμοὶ κόσμος ἐσταύρωται κἀγὼ κόσμῳ

passages.text: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything. What counts is a new creation.
passages.sermon: Circumcision does not matter.\r\nUncircumcision does not matter.\r\nA new creation is what matters.
passages.original: οὔτε γὰρ περιτομή τί ἐστιν οὔτε ἀκροβυστία ἀλλὰ καινὴ κτίσις

passages.text: Peace and mercy to all who walk by this rule, even to the Israel of God.
passages.sermon:
God gives peace to all who follow this rule.
God gives mercy to all who follow this rule.
God gives peace to the Israel of God.
God gives mercy to the Israel of God.
passages.original: Καὶ ὅσοι τῷ κανόνι τούτῳ στοιχήσουσιν εἰρήνη ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς καὶ ἔλεος καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραὴλ τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: From now on let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.
passages.sermon:
Paul is the speaker.
\r\nPaul follows Jesus Christ.
\r\nPaul says, "From now on, let no one cause me trouble."
\r\nI bear the marks of Jesus on my body.
\r\nThese marks show I belong to Jesus.
\r\nThese marks show I have suffered for Jesus.
passages.original: Τοῦ λοιποῦ κόπους μοι μηδεὶς παρεχέτω ἐγὼ γὰρ τὰ στίγματα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῷ σώματί μου βαστάζω

passages.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
passages.sermon:
Paul speaks to the believers in Galatia.
Paul calls them brothers.
Paul says, "The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit."
Paul ends with, "Amen."
passages.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματος ὑμῶν ἀδελφοί Ἀμήν
